caption:
A dua for your brother, straight from Musa

When Musa turned to his Lord, he did not ask forgiveness for himself alone. He included his brother in the same breath.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:151

Send this to your brother or sister and make this dua for them today.

#duaforfamily #siblings #prophetmusa #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: Moses said, “My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.” (Surah Al-A'raaf 7:151)
theme: dua for family / Musa's dua for himself and his brother
